title: Проект "Мой Дедлайн" (Продукт)
description: Напиши 5 предложений о своих планах на неделю. Укажи, что будет сделано (Future Perfect) и что будет в процессе (Future Continuous) в определенные моменты. (By Friday I will have finished my project. At 5 PM tomorrow I will be writing an essay...).
topic: Напиши 5 предложений о своих планах на неделю. Укажи, что будет сделано (Future Perfect) и что будет в процессе (Future Continuous) в определенные моменты.

conditions.label: Результат (Future Perfect)
conditions.hint: By Friday I will have finished my project.

conditions.label: Процесс (Future Continuous)
conditions.hint: At 5 PM tomorrow I will be writing an essay.

script.description: Пример: My Plans for the Week (Future Perfect + Future Continuous)
sentences: This week I have a lot of plans. By Monday evening, I will have finished all my homework for the week. On Tuesday at 4 p.m., I will be playing football with my friends at the school stadium.
By Wednesday afternoon, I will have cleaned my room and organised my desk. At 6 p.m. on Thursday, I will be helping my mum cook dinner for the family.

By Friday, I will have completed my big English project, so I will be free in the evening. At 5 p.m. on Saturday, I will be watching a new film with my sister. By Sunday night, I will have prepared everything for the next week, and I will be relaxing before Monday.
